snippet.title: Witchspire Reveal Trailer - Future Games Show gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Witchspire is a magic-infused survival game from Envar Studios that was revealed to the world during the Future Games Show at gamescom. It's coming soon to PC early access.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #witchspire
